user.title: Connect to Blade
user.description:
1. In the [Blade console]({console_url}), open your account menu and choose **API keys**.
2. Create a key and paste it below.

Blade sets up each service with the best models on your account.

insufficient_balance.title: Blade balance used up
insufficient_balance.description:
Blade refused a request: the account balance is used up.

Top up the wallet in the [Blade console]({console_url}). Calls resume by themselves.

paid_credit_required.title: Blade needs paid credit
paid_credit_required.description:
The free credit does not cover this model.

Add paid credit in the [Blade console]({console_url}).

invoice_unpaid.title: Blade invoice unpaid
invoice_unpaid.description:
Blade refused a request: an invoice is unpaid.

Settle it in the [Blade console]({console_url}).

monthly_budget_exceeded.title: Blade spending cap reached
monthly_budget_exceeded.description:
The spending cap set in the [Blade console]({console_url}) is reached.

Raise it there, or wait for next month.

payment_error.title: Blade payment problem
payment_error.description:
Blade refused a request for a billing reason.

Check the [Blade console]({console_url}).

local_budget_reached.title: Blade monthly cap reached
local_budget_reached.description:
This month's estimated spend reached your {budget} € cap: Blade calls are paused.

Raise the cap in the integration options, or wait for next month.
